'''Theron Mergott''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[September 2000 Rochester tournament (2 September)]] on 2 September 2000, according to Ted Panczyszyn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1199">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-04-rochester-ny-9-2-2000d1199/ rochester-ny-9-2-2000], DeckTech (Ted "Rogue15" Panczyszyn, 4 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-04-rochester-ny-9-2-2000d1199/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
